oḷāra: Oḷāra at PvA 110 is with v. l. BB to be read uḷāra.
oḷārika: Oḷārika (adj.) [fr. uḷāra] 총체의, 거친, 주목할 만한, 풍부한 (see on term Dhs trsl. 208 & Cpd. 159 n. 4) D I.37, 186 sq. (attā) 195, 197, 199; M I.48, 139, 247; II.230; III.16, 299; S II.275 (vihāra); III.47 (opp. sukhuma); IV.382 (id.); V.259 sq.; A IV.309 sq. (nimittaṁ obhāso); J I.67; Dhs 585, 675, 889; Vbh 1, 13, 379; Vism 155 (°anga), 274 sq. (호흡에 관한), 450.
oḷumpika: Oḷumpika (adj.) [Deriv. unknown, BSk. olumpika and oDumpika M Vastu III.113, 443. In the Śvet--Upan. we find the form uDupa a skiff.] Sen. Kacc 390 편주에 속한 (no ref. in Pāli Canon?); cp. BSk. olumpika M Vastu III. 113 & oDumpika ibid. 443.
